Veterinary Cancer Services
Serving a wide area on the front range, Veterinary Cancer services is a mobile oncology service that will travel to primary care veterinarian offices to treat patients within the comfort of their primary care office.
720-414-0116
Veterinarycancerservices@gmail.com
How this works

Booking
First of all, we want to acknowledge this is a very hard step to take: let us help make it smooth! Family veterinary offices are welcome to email records and client contact information and we will take it from there. Alternatively, pet parents are able to contact us by email, phone or text .
720-414-0116
veterinarycancerservices@gmail.com

Virtual consultation
We offer virtual consultations via zoom video or phone, directly with pet families. While we LOVE seeing your furry family members, pets are usually camera shy and do not need to participate in the call. Unsolicited pet pics always welcomed 🙂

Treatment visits
If treatment is elected, we meet in the comfort of the family veterinarian’s office. We will handle scheduling coordination between pet family and vet’s office. Appointment times can range from 30-60 minutes depending on the needs of the patient.

Medications
Your veterinarian is able to assist in general medications until we are able to meet in person. Once we have met you and your pet in person, we are able to help with prescription management pertaining to their cancer or treatment.

Billing
Consultations are billed directly to the pet parent and payments are received online via invoice links.
Estimates for treatment/procedure costs are provided by the family veterinarian and payable to them directly.

In-Person appointment
All treatment appointments are in-person and families are able to chat with us in person.
We do offer in-person consultations at request, however, availability is limited. Please contact us for more information.
Vets, We are here for you too!
If you would like some guidance on a case, feel free to email case information and specific questions. We will gladly get on the phone or email with a little help! Feel free to text us too!
veterinarycancerservices@gmail.com
Privacy Policy
Privacy Policy for Company Texting
This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, uses, shares, and protects personal information when you interact with our company text messaging programs (SMS, MMS, RCS, or similar). By providing your phone number and using our messaging services, you agree to the practices described below.
Information we collect
Phone number and message metadata (timestamps, carrier, message IDs). Message content you send to us (questions, replies, keywords).Minimal device information (device type, language) and delivery status. Transaction or account identifiers where messages relate to your account or purchases.
How we use your information
Deliver messages you request (order updates, appointment reminders, verification codes). Respond to your inquiries and provide customer support via text. Personalize message timing and content.
Consent and message frequency
Message frequency is related to your patient client relationship with your nurses and doctors. You may revoke consent at any time by texting the designated STOP keyword or following unsubscribe instructions in messages.
Sharing and third parties
We may share your information with service providers that facilitate messaging (SMS gateway providers, marketing platforms, analytics vendors) under contract and only to the extent needed to deliver the service. We may disclose information to comply with law, protect rights, or in connection with a business transfer (sale, merger, bankruptcy) with reasonable protections for your data.
Data retention
We retain phone numbers, message records, and consent records for as long as necessary to provide services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. Retention periods vary by message type and legal/regulatory requirements; we will delete or de-identify data when no longer needed.
Security
We implement administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect personal information (access controls, encryption where feasible, monitoring). No method of transmission or storage is completely secure; we work to minimize risk and will notify you as required by law in the event of a breach.
Children
Our texting programs are not intended for children under 16 (or applicable minimum age). We do not knowingly collect phone numbers from minors. If we learn we collected a minor’s information without consent, we will delete it.
Contact
Questions or requests about this policy, access, correction, or deletion Veterinary Cancer Services Attn: Privacy, veterinarycancerservices@gmail.com
If you have a case question, we invite you to reach out via email with case information and your specific questions. We will happily get on the phone or email you back with a little guidance!
VCS Team
Behind Veterinary Cancer Services, you not only get professionals in the field, you get compassionate humans who love helping animals and their families achieve a better quality of life. We strive for a level of care that is honest and kind. Oncology is a tough area to navigate, so we are happy to be your compass.
